messages:
leah: heads-up: we finished the memory-aware quantization + cache-steering experiment. early numbers show lower p99 tail and fewer OOMs on dense long-context pools. moving to staged rollout.

leah: Short numbers (mixed-prod):
```text
Before: p99=280ms, OOMs/day=6, cost/token=$0.00118
After:  p99=235ms, OOMs/day=1, cost/token=$0.00100
KV-prefetch hitrate: 36% -> 49%
GPU memory pressure: -12%
```

omar: nice. any loss in model quality from quantization changes?

leah: no measurable quality drift on our eval sets. we used mixed-8bit with per-block calibration and only applied to warm model shards. kept fp32 for attention-heavy kernels.

jira-bot: Created ENG-4821: "rollout: mem-aware-quant + cache-steer" and assigned to @omar. Link: https://redwood.internal/jira/ENG-4821

omar: rollout plan? auto-rollback gates?

leah: plan: canary(2%) -> 10% -> 40% -> 100%. hold at each step for 30m. gates: p99 regression >4% or OOMs increase OR model-decoding-error bump >0.2% => rollback. rollback = feature-flag flip, infra runbook updated.

jordan: can you attach the per-seqlen breakdown for the wiki? want bins 0-512,512-2k,2k-6k. also need the Grafana snapshot.

leah: will push artifacts to the PR and runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/mem-quant-steer. attaching dashboards now.

omar: shout if you want me to pause last step until we notify top customers.

leah: good idea. we'll pause at 40% and send account leads a short note. thanks everyone.

(automated) metrics logged: p50/p95/p99, OOM-rate, cost/token, kv-hit, gpu-mem, decode-errors.
